composition.currentLayout: The Audience destination has People, Audiences, Forms, and Responses peer tabs under one organizer scope. People presents CRM summary, search, grouped filters, Sort/Filters controls, export, manual add, duplicate review and a paginated divided directory; nested routes own full-page add and customer detail. Audiences presents explanatory ownership copy and one flat divided saved-audience directory with one New audience section action; full-page routes own create, detail, edit, exact preview and archive. Forms and Responses reuse the same Audience chrome while retaining their specialized authoring and review routes. The Messaging bridge persists and previews an eligible People filter before opening Sends by id, but campaign composition lives only in Messaging.
composition.targetLayout: Keep Audience as the sole CRM and intake owner with first-class People, Audiences, Forms, and Responses peer views. Keep add-customer chrome People-specific, audience creation singular and explicit, form authoring nested, and message composition in Messaging.
